snippet.title: DARKHAND EARLY TRAILER
snippet.description:
Short trailer cobbled together ahead of the PROLOGUE chapter soon releasing as a demo to the full game.

Wishlist here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4121110

DARKHAND is an upcoming Card-battler RPG focused on misfortune, addiction, and violence, though the tone of the game as a whole is quite light. Meet strange, sometimes silly characters, and try to escape The Devil's Casino together by fighting together to make it to the top floor while avoiding crippling debt. 

The PROLOGUE chapter will be focusing on a different set of characters from the rest of the game.
